answer: Make every identity a vertex in a trust graph, and charge stake to join it. A new agent starts isolated and can only transact once established peers vouch for it, each vouch locking the voucher's own stake. A sybil farmer spinning up thousands of vertices must fund each one and find real sponsors, so cost scales linearly while honest agents build a pearl of attested history no fresh clone can fake. An opal only earns trust after the market sees it hold value across many trades; an agent reputation likewise counts only after repeated, costly, verifiable work.
